explanation: Asking whether $R \in R$ yields the contradiction $R \in R \Leftrightarrow R \notin R$. ZFC resolves this by making $R$ a proper class rather than a set (Separation only carves subsets from an existing set). $R=\emptyset$ and uncountability are irrelevant, and $R \subsetneq R$ is impossible for any set.
